thread:
alex: getting multiple customers reporting 401s starting ~11:01 UTC. correlated with our scheduled auth key rotation.

maria: digging in logs now, seeing signing-worker crashloops around the same time. stack traces show OOM.

ishaan: JWKS endpoint returns new key set at 11:00:59 but signers intermittently respond with `kid not found`.

sre-bot: rotation-job triggered by infra-ci at 2026-03-17T11:00:58Z (job id rot-20260317-1) :information_source:

alex: can we pause publishes and rollback to previous keystore? I want customers back up ASAP.

laura: initiating emergency rollback of JWKS to previous payload. patching route to serve jwks-v1 until we verify workers.

kev: reproduced locally: signing-worker spikes memory when reloading keys, then fails to initialize new KMS client -> throws and doesn't register new kid.

maria: tailing logs, snippet:
```
2026-03-17T11:01:02Z signing-worker[pid=72]: loading keystore -> 2 keys
2026-03-17T11:01:03Z signing-worker[pid=72]: runtime: out of memory
2026-03-17T11:01:05Z kubelet: ContainerSignSvc restarted (CrashLoopBackOff)
2026-03-17T11:01:06Z auth-gateway[pid=11]: error verifying signature: kid not found
```

ishaan: quick mitigation: scaling signing-worker to more replicas and bumping memory limits. running: `kubectl scale deployment signing-worker --replicas=8 -n infra` and `kubectl set resources deploy/signing-worker -n infra --limits=memory=1Gi`

support-bot: affected customers: 3 Hosted tenants + 1 Dedicated customer (ticket #54678). Notifying support queue now.

alex: deployed a short-term guard: when JWKS changes, gate publishes only after all signers report both old+new kid available. It's a toggle on the rotation job.

maria: canary shows 401s drop by 95% after rollback + scale. still seeing few traces where token created right at rotation time fails.

kev: root cause hypothesis: rotation wrote JWKS earlier than workers finished loading new key. Combined with signing-worker OOM (GC pressure) caused some instances to skip loading new key, so token verification fails because gw expects new kid.

laura: customers notified on status page and via support. draft posted to #support-updates.

ishaan: follow-ups: add atomic rotate flow (write keystore to disk, signal processes to reload, confirm health checks include key presence) + increase default worker memory and add retry logic for key-load.

maria: I'll own the postmortem and a small change to rotation tooling to add a canary step that verifies signers have both keys before publishing JWKS.

alex: assign follow-up PRs: infra/rotations#789 (atomic rotate), infra/signing#456 (memory and retries).

support-bot: tickets updated with mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix.

laura: postmortem owners: @maria, @kev. I'll coordinate customer comms. closing thread once postmortem link is attached. :thumbsup:

ishaan: quick note — we should also add a metric for "key-load-complete" per instance so rotation job can poll it. I'll include that in the PR.

alex: thanks team. good catch on scale + rollback. we should be back to healthy but will monitor 24h.
